verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line saying LM Studio's headless local server offers "structured outputs via llama.cpp or Apple MLX". That indicates some constrained-output capability, but nothing shows how it works or that it uses grammars. Missing for 10: documentation of JSON schema/JSON mode request parameters, explicit grammar-based constraint support (e.g. GBNF), API usage details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
